comments_text: Expression: after Vibrio anguillarum challenge, the mRNA transcript of VpBD increased 7.4 fold during the first 24 hr and 3.9 fold after 96 h. Activity: Recombinant peptide displayed activity against both G+ S. aureus (MIC 1.64-3.28 uM), M-luteus (MIC >26.26 uM), Bacillus sp. (MIC 13.13-26.26 uM) and G- bacteria V. anguillarum (MIC 13.13-26.26 uM), E-cloacae (MIC >26.26 uM), V. ichthyoenteri (MIC 3.28-6.56 uM), P. putida (MIC 1.64-3.28 uM), P-mirabilis (MIC>26.26 uM), and Enterobacter sp. (MIC 13.13-26.26 uM). Recombinant production:bacteria:Escherichia coli: a recombinant BL21 (DE3)-plysS expression system was established for production of the peptide. 10/30/2010; 3/2023.
